_comment: Seamless 512x512 honeycomb tile for use as a CSS background-image. Low-opacity gold-on-near-black; the page-side CSS controls opacity. Generates with tileable=true via the SDXL CFG-rescale + seamless approach. Output: ~/ComfyUI/output/mixhive-honeycomb-tile_*.png. Copy to public/art/honeycomb-tile.png.

inputs.text: seamless tileable pattern, perfectly repeating hexagonal honeycomb grid, six-sided cells in dark amber gold (#f5b800) hairline outline on a matte black background, subtle metallic glint, micro chrome highlights at each vertex, ultra precise vector-clean geometry, top-down orthographic view, no shading variation between cells, no center vignette, no edge gradient, edges align exactly so tile-x and tile-y are mathematically continuous

irregular cells, broken honeycomb, asymmetric, gradient lighting, vignette, watermark, signature, text, photography, organic shapes, perspective view, depth, shadow, glow, soft focus, color variation, beige, cream

30._comment: Crop center 512x512 from the 1024x1024 generation — gives the cleanest tile interior. The hand-runbook step then verifies seamlessness by tiling 2x2 in an image editor.
